_meta.about: Towns whose boundaries touch, for the free watchlist area (a town plus its neighbors). Keys and values are site town ids (<ST>:<Town>); keys starting with '_' are not towns.
_meta.source: US Census Bureau, cartographic boundary files, county subdivisions, 1:500,000

method.rule: neighbors when the boundaries come within buffer_m of each other along at least min_shared_m; towns across water the Census clips at the shoreline (ocean, sounds, Narragansett Bay) are not neighbors; across rivers and unclipped bays the line in the water counts
method.ny_names: NY towns on the site keep their site id; other NY names used by more than one town or city get ' (city)' or ' (<County> County)' added; New York City's boroughs are listed by name; a city split across counties is one entry; NY Indian reservations are left out
method.states: MA, RI and NY, including neighbors across their shared state lines; other states are not included
